title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Rosa Fairgrounds on 1970-12-12
lineage: SBD > MR > Cassette > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A soundboard recording with some hiss and splices that still delivers a hot Other One, blazing China Cat Sunflower, and solid blues‑heavy jams.
ai_review.review: The show captures the Dead in fine form – Jerry’s guitar is on fire through China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider and Hard to Handle, while Pigpen shines on Good Lovin' and a scorching Other One. The SBD source has noticeable hiss and a few splice‑related cuts (especially in The Other One), but overall the audio is clear enough to enjoy the strong blues set and jam‑filled second half.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the performance 4‑5 stars, praising key songs and band energy; recording issues are noted but not severe enough to outweigh the musical strengths.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable hiss and occasional splice/cut (especially in The Other One); some volume fluctuations on I Know You Rider, but overall clear and listenable SBD.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
poor_songs: The Other One (cut in the middle)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A well‑balanced set that moves from upbeat blues numbers to extended jams; strong second half with back‑to‑back high‑energy songs and seamless transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for laser‑beam tone on China Cat, hot licks on Hard to Handle, and soaring solos on The Other One and Darkness Jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for a solid solo on China Cat Sunflower, adding good rhythm guitar texture throughout.
